description: The SFTP connector supports actions to interact with SFTP server.

1b1d56b7-4b73-4c3e-af6e-a04162eef4ec.name: UPLOAD
1b1d56b7-4b73-4c3e-af6e-a04162eef4ec.description: Uploads a file to the sftp server

inputs.name: contentReferences
inputs.description: The content parameter holding the reference to the content to be uploaded.

inputs.name: remotePath
inputs.description: Destination path on the SFTP server where the file will be uploaded

inputs.name: allowOverwrite
inputs.description: Whether to allow overwriting existing files on the SFTP server. If set to false and a file with the same name already exists at the destination path, the upload will fail with a conflict error.

errors.name: SERVICE_ERROR
errors.description: General error code for service failures.

errors.name: SFTP_CONNECTION_FAILED
errors.description: Failed to establish the SFTP session.

errors.name: SFTP_KEY_INVALID
errors.description: The SFTP host public key is invalid or malformed.

errors.name: SFTP_KEY_UNSUPPORTED
errors.description: The SFTP host key type is not supported.

errors.name: SFTP_FILE_ALREADY_EXISTS
errors.description: A file already exists at the target remote path on the SFTP server and overwrite is not allowed.

errors.name: TIMEOUT_ERROR
errors.description: The operation exceeded the timeout period.

config.name: SFTP_HOST_PUBLIC_KEY
config.description: Public key of the SFTP host, used to verify the identity of the server. Note: Either the public key or the fingerprint must be provided.

config.name: SFTP_PUBLIC_HOST_FINGERPRINT
config.description: Fingerprint of the public SFTP host key used to verify the server identity. Note: Either the public key or the fingerprint must be provided. Only SHA-256 fingerprints are supported.

name: fssdf
